literature.title: The neurotoxicity of antibacterial agents.
literature.abstract: Commonly used antibacterial agents may be associated with various neurotoxic reactions. Central nervous system toxicities include seizure disorders, encephalopathy, bulging fontanelles, and neuropsychiatric symptoms. These abnormalities have been associated with the use of the penicillins, cephalosporins, sulfonamides, tetracyclines, chloramphenicol, colistin, aminoglycosides, metronidazole, isoniazid, rifampin, ethionamide, cycloserine, and dapsone. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: ⚠️ 負向證據警示（Adverse Effect Direction）：現有全部文獻均記錄 INH 本身為運動神經炎的已知病因，而非治療藥物。機轉為 INH 競爭性抑制吡哆醛激酶，導致維生素 B6 耗竭，進而引起周圍神經病變（以慢代謝者/slow acetylators 為高風險族群）。此適應症方向與藥物毒性特性完全相反，再利用方向不成立，不應進入後續評估。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 唯一文獻（PMID 5302244, 1968）描述先天性結核病以中耳炎為初始表現的個案，屬於 TB 全身感染的局部耳部表現，非一般感染性中耳炎（主要病原：肺炎鏈球菌、流感嗜血桿菌、卡他莫拉菌）。INH 對上述常見病原菌無療效，機轉關聯極為薄弱且僅限結核病因亞型。
